summary: The canteen has an overall rating of 2.5 out of 5 based on 107 aspect mentions. Waiting time, quantity, and price were the biggest concerns, with 88%, 80%, and 75% of mentions respectively being negative. Food quality and hygiene were less negative than these areas, but still often criticised, with 49% and 60% of mentions respectively being negative.

The classrooms received an overall rating of 2.66 out of 5 from student feedback. Noise was the biggest concern, with 73% of mentions being negative. Lighting and projector/av equipment were also major issues, with 64% and 62% of mentions being negative, respectively. The classrooms also received criticism for ac/temperature and seating, with 45% and 46% of mentions being negative, but these areas were less negative than the others.

The hostel mess received an overall rating of 2.33 out of 5 from student feedback. The biggest concerns were the lack of variety, with 89% of mentions being negative, and the limited quantity of food, with 86% of mentions being negative. Waiting time was also a significant issue, with 83% of mentions being negative. Few complaints were made about staff behavior, with only 33% of mentions being negative, while price was less negative than other areas but still often criticised, with 43% of mentions being negative.

The overall rating for the hostel rooms is 2.28 out of 5, based on 89 aspect mentions. Noise, maintenance, and water supply are the biggest concerns, with all 7 noise mentions, 88% of maintenance mentions and 73% of water supply mentions being negative. Cleanliness and electricity are less negative areas, with 43% of cleanliness mentions and 43% of electricity mentions being negative.

The labs received an overall rating of 2.89 out of 5 from student feedback. The biggest concerns were equipment condition, lab timings, and software availability, with 75%, 59%, and 54% of mentions, respectively, being negative. The labs were less criticized in terms of space and cleanliness, with 14% and 33% of mentions being negative, respectively, but still had some complaints in these areas.

The library received an overall rating of 2.53 out of 5, based on 106 aspect mentions. The biggest concerns were with the air conditioning/temperature, with 73% of mentions being negative, followed by opening hours (71%) and book availability (70%). In contrast, digital resources received relatively few complaints, with only 22% of mentions being negative. Staff behavior was also criticized, with 46% of mentions being negative, although less so than the other areas.

The transport has an overall rating of 2.49 out of 5 based on 106 aspect mentions. The biggest concerns include crowding, with 88% of mentions being negative, and bus condition, with 73% of mentions being negative. The transport also received criticism for safety, with 62% of mentions being negative. Few complaints were made about driver behavior, with 38% of mentions being negative, while fare was less negative than other areas but still often criticised, with 57% of mentions being negative.

The wifi has an overall rating of 2.33 out of 5. The biggest concerns with the wifi are login issues, with 76% of mentions being negative, and reliability, with 73% of mentions being negative. The wifi also has issues with speed, with 67% of mentions being negative. Coverage and connectivity are less negative than these areas, but still often criticised, with 47% and 61% of mentions being negative, respectively.
